previous_turn: PROGRESS: alternative switch electrical screening recorded
purpose: Remove the selectable SETI shunt instead of adding a powered-off protected switch. Charging speed is not a user requirement.

conditional_current_screen.basis: Existing MAX4995 coefficients specified at 3.3 V; NOT qualified at USB 5 V
conditional_current_screen.meaning: With no input collapse and negligible overhead, system above this residual requires charging reduction. These are not guaranteed operating margins.

power_path_evidence.finding: BQ25185 reduces charging when SYS droops; battery supplement can supply excess system load above battery UVLO. Existing 4.1 V resistor mode has 500 mA internal limit, so external fixed limit remains necessary.

required_before_adoption: Verify external limiter at USB voltage, upstream current and inrush; 3.3 V coefficients are insufficient.
Check worst-case USB transfer current and low-battery behavior; supplement must not trip battery protection or MCU BOR.
Check interaction of external limiter and charger VINDPM/DPPM, including depleted-battery startup.
Remove high-budget GPIO drive in firmware and update USB descriptor/policy consistently; retain suspend isolation.
Generate schematic and PCB variant; verify parity, DRC, power-path nets and reclaimed area.
expected_benefit: Eliminates SETI switch leakage and analog powered-off sequencing mechanism; removes 3 canonical parts or 4 TMUX trial parts. Does not resolve all power-path risks.
